# WorldBox Modding Docs — AI entry point

Frozen evidence baseline: WorldBox 0.51.2 build 719 / NeoModLoader 1.2.0.1 / PoliticalWorldAPI 1.14.0 where applicable.

WBML systematic research is frozen at 1.0 after canonical 0.2–0.9 integration. Start with:
- /worldbox-modding-docs/data/wbml/manifest.json
- /worldbox-modding-docs/data/wbml/1000-practical-modding-baseline.json
- /worldbox-modding-docs/ai/wbml-machine-data/

Important rules:
- Do not invent WorldBox APIs.
- VERIFIED means exact tested scope only.
- OBSERVED does not widen into a stable public contract.
- Same logical ID after reload does not guarantee the same CLR reference; prefer re-resolution.
- Bounded lifecycle windows are not permanent-persistence claims.
- Method-family census does not mean every matching method is safe.
- If the question is outside evidence, keep it explicit as research-needed/unknown.
- Re-open systematic WBML only after WorldBox/NML changes or a direct contradiction to the frozen baseline.
